programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Battlefield 3-D, Drone Tech, 2-man Orcasub"
programs.desc: The innovative combination of 3D video and drone technology gives infantry soldiers an accurate battlefield picture. Northrop Grumman's top European executive shares their predictions on how technology will change the way we fight.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle"
programs.sub_title: USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle
programs.desc: We reveal eye-witness intelligence on the USS Zumwalt, America's ultra-hi tech, four billion dollar guided missile destroyer. Learn more about the British firm who've developed Minerva, an ingenious, low-cost but realistic tank simulator.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programs.sub_title: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
programs.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programs.sub_title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programs.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programs.sub_title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programs.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programs.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programs.sub_title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programs.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.
